seo.intro: Bangkok is mainland Southeast Asia's primary aviation crossroads, served by Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) for long-haul flag carriers and Don Mueang International Airport (DMK) primarily for regional low-cost routes.
seo.title: Direct Flights from Bangkok: Nonstop Routes & Airports | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Explore nonstop connections from Suvarnabhumi (BKK) and Don Mueang (DMK)
seo.meta_description: Discover all nonstop flight routes departing Bangkok. Compare Suvarnabhumi (BKK) and Don Mueang (DMK), operating airlines, and flight durations.

faqs.answer: Choose Suvarnabhumi (BKK) for full-service international flights, long-haul connections, and Airport Rail Link train access. Choose Don Mueang (DMK) for regional low-cost carriers including AirAsia, Nok Air, and Lion Air.
faqs.question: Which airport in Bangkok should I fly out of?

faqs.answer: Bangkok offers direct nonstop flights to over 140 destinations worldwide, spanning ASEAN capital cities, East Asia, South Asia, Europe, and Australasia.
faqs.question: How many direct destinations are reachable from Bangkok?

faqs.answer: Allow at least 3.5 to 4 hours between connecting flights. The driving distance between BKK and DMK is approximately 45 km, taking 50 to 90 minutes by expressway depending on traffic.
faqs.question: How much time is required to transfer between BKK and DMK?
